title: Frontend Developer
description: We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with experience in React and Next.js to join our growing team.
responsibilities: Build responsive UI components using React and Next.js
Collaborate with designers to implement pixel-perfect interfaces
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
Participate in code reviews and team discussions
requirements: Experience with Tailwind CSS or similar

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Join our design team to create beautiful, user-centered digital experiences for our clients.
responsibilities: Design wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups
Conduct user research and usability testing
Maintain and evolve the design system
Collaborate closely with developers during implementation

title: Backend Engineer
description: We need a strong Java/Spring Boot engineer to build and maintain our backend systems.
responsibilities: Design and build RESTful APIs using Spring Boot
Manage database schemas and migrations with Flyway
Collaborate with frontend team on API contracts
requirements: Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines

title: Project Manager
description: Lead client projects from discovery to delivery, coordinating between teams and stakeholders.
responsibilities: Manage project timelines, budgets, and deliverables
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients
Facilitate daily standups and sprint planning
requirements: Familiarity with tools like Jira or Notion
